description: Generic object detection operation using device-backed model if available or CPU fallback. Supports compiled models (.dfp) with optional post-processing or standalone ONNX models. Returns detections as dictionaries with bbox, score, and class_id.

model_path.description: Path to device-compatible model file. Can be compiled model (.dfp) for MX3 with optional post-processing, or standalone ONNX model (.onnx) for CPU/GPU/MX3. If omitted, CPU fallback is used.

device_id.description: Identifier for compute device from ComputePool. Required if model_path is provided.

post_processing_model_path.description: Optional path to ONNX post-processing model. Used with compiled models (.dfp) to convert raw outputs to detections.

max_detections.description: Maximum number of detections to return.

is_grayscale.description: Whether the model expects grayscale input (single channel) instead of RGB (3 channels). Set to true for grayscale models, false for RGB models.
